items.title_kr: Kohl's, 1,100개 이상 store에서 on-demand delivery 서비스 본격 확대
items.title_en: Kohl's Starts On Demand Delivery From More Than 1,100 Stores
items.body_kr: Kohl's가 미국 내 1,100개 이상의 store를 활용한 on-demand delivery 서비스를 시작하며 Holiday season fulfillment 경쟁력을 강화합니다. 당사 밴더사들은 연말 E-commerce 채널의 물동량 증가 추이를 모니터링해야 합니다.
items.body_en: Kohl's has launched on-demand delivery across over 1,100 stores to boost fulfillment capabilities for the Holiday season. Vendors should monitor inventory flow and shipping demands across digital retail channels.

items.title_kr: Abercrombie & Fitch, 역대급 Q3 실적 기록 후 guidance 상향 조정
items.title_en: Abercrombie & Fitch Posts Record Q3 Sales and Raises Outlook
items.body_kr: Abercrombie & Fitch가 11%의 탄탄한 Q3 매출 성장을 기록하며 연간 outlook을 상향 조정했습니다. 양호한 실적 모멘텀이 이어짐에 따라 향후 재고 reorder 및 신규 sourcing 물량 확대에 긍정적인 신호가 될 것입니다.
items.body_en: Abercrombie & Fitch posted record Q3 sales growth of 11% and raised its annual outlook. This strong momentum signals healthy consumer demand and potential reorder opportunities for vendor partners.

items.title_kr: Kohl's, Christmas Day 휴점 및 Christmas Eve 단축 영업 결정
items.title_en: Kohl's to Close Christmas Day, Early Christmas Eve
items.body_kr: Kohl's announced store closures for Christmas Day and early hours on Christmas Eve. Sales teams should account for these holiday operating schedules when planning end-of-season promotional campaigns.

items.title_kr: Macy's, 제100회 Thanksgiving Day Parade 성공적 개최 및 exclusive merchandise 주목
items.title_en: Macy's Celebrates 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade with Exclusive Brands
items.body_kr: Macy's successfully hosted the milestone 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade, driving strong customer traffic and brand engagement. Industry watchers are eyeing the sell-through performance of exclusive parade merchandise.

items.title_kr: Macy's, Black Friday 앞두고 500개 이상 fashion deals 및 할인 행사 전개
items.title_en: Macy's Drops 500+ Black Friday Fashion Deals Up to 65% Off
items.body_kr: Macy's rolled out over 500 Black Friday fashion deals offering steep discounts to kick off the holiday shopping rush. The market is tracking early inventory clearance rates across these major promotional categories.
